automation.name: Sigrun Gen133 anti-CPR heritage and delivery loop

fail_closed_boundaries: WIP equals one and each tick stops after one terminal result.
Unexpected staged or unstaged work causes HOLD without repair.
Exact mappings and source bodies never enter Git, logs, Slack, providers, or permaweb.
The nonempty unknown-owner Slack draft is never inspected, mutated, or sent.
Provider transmission and Arweave upload, spend, wallet, and credential effects are forbidden.
After successful v11 readback, the same automation is updated in place and unchanged work is suppressed.
claim_boundary: ACTIVE configuration proves a registered wake mechanism, not that a future tick ran or completed.
This receipt does not prove v11 completion, identity, continuity, rights, independent review, delivery, ConsumerAck, publication, income, or operator relief.
honest_flaw: The next tick still executes through the same agent/thread environment; durable scheduling does not provide semantic independence or guarantee successful Git/network effects.
falsifier: Automation registry parse failure, inactive status, config hash mismatch, pending-file byte mismatch, unexpected worktree change, or any forbidden effect.
next_safe_action: Allow the existing hourly heartbeat to execute its single seven-row v11 successor work item.
